title: Keep an event in its place in time
communicates: When events begin and end, and which intervals overlap.
observation: ValueTracker supports a changing numerical value driving an animation.
interpretation: Use one shared time value for all lanes; leave completed intervals visible. This timeline design is our adaptation, not a copied Manim example.
avoid: Animating a future event as if it already happened.
Resetting a completed event on every frame.
